variants.question_text: Which lane has the clearest forward path with lowest hazard density?
variants.description: Perception-first: queries environmental state facts before mapping to action space.

variants.question_text: Which action should we take right now: move_left, stay, or move_right?
variants.description: Direct-action control: prompts Laya directly for a strategic move without perception framing.

variants.question_text: At current velocity {speed}x, which lane allows safe avoidance given collision time {distance/speed}s?
variants.description: Speed-scaled physics framing: explicitly supplies dynamic time-to-collision.

variants.question_text: Obstacle is located at distance {distance}. Which lane has no obstacle?
variants.description: Static grid framing: reports obstacle distance without speed scaling.
